correctness.rationale: The proof partitions candidates by zero count and uses unique phase of each exact full zero-to-zero gap. The one-zero language is the union of two dominated rectangles; the only minimal missed corner is (b+1,a+1). There are exactly two exceptional two-zero extensions and two missed three-zero transitions; interior phase uniqueness excludes all higher-zero candidates. The derived list has seven isolated terms plus c-3 other full-gap exclusions, and its computed sets were exhaustively cross-checked for 2024 triples through c=24, as well as independent direct circular indexing on selected samples.

value.rationale: A complete antidictionary classification for every member of a natural infinite family of primitive binary necklaces with exactly three separated rare symbols provides an exact symbolic alternative to factor enumeration. The largest-gap-only c+4 law and the zero-count profile identify nonobvious invariants relevant to circular reconstruction and forbidden-factor representations; this is not a fixed numerical census or an arbitrary parameter slice.
